answer.explanation: The live configuration of the Thumbnailer function has MemorySize 128 and Timeout 3, while the committed SAM template specifies MemorySize 1024 and Timeout 30. The function was last modified at 01:46:54Z, just before the window opened, so this is an out-of-band configuration change that drifted from the intended state. The other three functions match the template. The Thumbnailer log group shows no timeout or memory errors in the window, so impact is not yet visible in the logs. The reduced memory and timeout are the likely risk.
